decisions.reason: Uses symptom-log and contrast-probe: the tab is titled but meta.status stays 'none' while file-trace's own RPC reads the same file, ruling out disk, session resolution and the tab renderer, and localizing the stall to the workspace-files resource-provider/Remote metadata chain; notes the host row is already declared in the bundle patch and that static serving does not prove activation. Peripheral change-card references are unsupported but the diagnosis itself is grounded.

Correctly distinguishes the 62/62 per-module sweep (valid static-serving measurement) from the ~4-5 KB all-joined URL 404 (invalid; reflects URL-length/concat limits and the loader never sends it), and explains the loader fetches the __DSH_BOOT__ roster per-module. But the manifest-says-60 vs probe-says-62 discrepancy is quoted on both sides without any explicit evidence-bounded treatment.

Separates the paste-input fold warnings as an independent cosmetic message-fold defect with no contact with the resource layer, and uses the boot manifest to explain the textpreview-to-documentpreview rename and the new session-only canOpen scope as the cause of the absolute-address claim failure, explicitly not the stalled session-tab metadata; demands no fold-parser version.

Gives the correct order: cheap restart first, then rollback to the verified 0.1.3-alpha.2 escape hatch from discussion #5999, then upstream follow-up; rejects plugin-side rewrite, retry storms and client fallbacks, and treats the alpha.1 roster mismatch as prior art. However, duplicate service insertion is never explicitly rejected as a cure, as the criterion requires.

Packages versions/upgrade history, exact absolute/session addresses and symptoms, the roster excerpt, the valid per-module sweep with the invalid-join caveat, the same-file contrast and meta.status, plus console evidence; proposes named host diagnostics including a boot self-probe of the workspaceFiles Remote requiring a non-'none' meta.status within a timeout and a degraded flag, beyond mere roster-vs-byte checks.

caps.reason: The report affirmatively states the joined-URL 404 is not evidence modules are missing and that citing it as such would be false attribution; the sweep proves every module serves.
The final recommendation rejects plugin rewrites, blind retries and fallback re-implementations of the host read, directing the fix at host rollback and upstream instead.
